content.title: Ethena’s USDe sheds 40% of supply as traders cool on risky crypto bets
content.summary: The amount of Ethena's USDe in circulation fell 40% over the past month. Low funding rates caused by instability in the crypto markets is driving the decline. More interest rate cuts from the Federal Reserve could turn things around.

thumbnail.caption: The supply of USDe fell from an all-time high of almost $15 billion at the start of October to around $8.5 billion. Credit: Darren Joseph / Pexels / Freepik

content.title: Mega Matrix to Expand $2B Digital Asset Treasury into Multi-Stablecoin Framework
